title: Stream a result set page by page
prompt: Write a standalone TypeScript ESM program that streams every feature of the Esri GeoServices FeatureServer layer at <HONUA_EVAL_BASE_URL> (service "EvalIncidents", layer 0) in pages of 2. Use the contract API from @honua/sdk-js: HonuaClient with { baseUrl }, createDataset from @honua/sdk-js/contract with one source { id: "incidents", protocol: "geoservices-feature-service", locator: { url: <base URL>, serviceId: "EvalIncidents", layerId: 0 }, capabilities: PROTOCOL_DEFAULT_CAPABILITIES["geoservices-feature-service"] } and skipCompatibilityCheck: true. Iterate source.stream({ where: "1=1", pagination: { limit: 2 } }) with for await; each iteration yields a Result page whose features array holds at most 2 features. Print exactly one line to stdout: {"pages": <number of pages>, "total": <total features across pages>}.

context.notes: Golden workflow: async-generator pagination via Source.stream().
